channel.title: UNICEF Job Vacancies (Filtered)
channel.description: Filtered UNICEF job vacancies: Professional (P-1 to P-5), Director (D-1/D-2), internships and fellowships.

item.title: Internship: Innovation Data and Knowledge Intern (6 months, full time) - Office of Innovation, Stockholm, Sweden (In-person)
item.description: This internship is with the Insights & Evidence Team, Systems & Services section, in UNICEF’s Office of Innovation (OOI). We act as UNICEF’s innovation intelligence function, helping the organization understand what works, what doesn’t, why, and where innovation can generate the greatest impact for children. You will work alongside innovation and knowledge management practitioners, with opportunities to prototype and test your own ideas and to gain skills in systems thinking and human-centered design in a global organization. You will experiment with AI-enabled solutions, automate workflows and explore ways to better connect and streamline existing knowledge and data systems.

item.title: Fund Raising Specialist (P-3), Temporary Position, 364 days, #139042, Private Fund Raising and Partnerships - Rome, Italy
item.description: Under the guidance of Fundraising Manager, the Fundraising Specialist (Major Donors) for the Global Philanthropy team will lead the work with the UNICEF International Council (UIC), in particular the design and implementation of the Council regional events, the Annual Symposium and to facilitate the work of the Chair, Vice Chairs and working group leads.

item.title: Social & Behavior Change Specialist (P-3), TA, #139110, (364 days), Gaza, Palestine, MENA
item.description: Social and Behaviour Change in UNICEF is a cross-cutting programme strategy that addresses the cognitive, social and structural determinants of social change in both development and humanitarian contexts. SBC uses the latest in social and behavioral sciences to understand people, their beliefs, values, and the socio-cultural norms that shape their lives, with the aim of engaging them and increasing their influence in the design of solutions for sustainable behavior and social change. SBC is at the core of UNICEF’s mandate, with corporate results across sectors revolving around social and behavioral practices like immunization, breastfeeding, hygiene, and positive discipline.

item.title: Nutrition Specialist (P-3), FT, #072398, Dar Es Salaam, United Rep. of Tanzania-ESAR
item.description: The Nutrition Specialist supports the development and preparation of the nutrition programme and is responsible for managing, implementing, monitoring, evaluating, and reporting the programme progress of the Food Systems for Children portfolio of the Child Nutrition and Development section within the country programme. The Nutrition Specialist provides technical guidance and management support throughout the programming processes to facilitate the administration and achievement of concrete and sustainable results in the section (lifecycle) Diets outputs, particularly complementary foods, food supplements, food environment, overweight and obesity prevention initiatives, inclusive of legal framework ones and programmes. This is carried out according to plans, allocation, results-based management approaches and methodology (RBM), as well as UNICEF’s Strategic Plans, standards of performance, and accountability framework.To be corrected in the VA: It usually indicates UNDAF and needs to be updated to UNSDCF to ensure accuracy.

item.title: Health Manager (MNCH and PHC) (P-4), FT, #00090478, Addis Ababa - Ethiopia
item.description: UNICEF Ethiopia is seeking an experienced health professional with an advanced university degree in public health, medicine or a related field, and at least eight years of progressively responsible professional experience in health programme management. Candidates with demonstrated experience in programme and team leadership, leading organizational or programmatic change, managing complex health programmes, influencing partners and government stakeholders, resource mobilization, and driving innovation will be strongly preferred.

item.title: SSRRE 2027-2028: Representative, D-2, New Delhi, India
item.description: The Representative serves as the accredited representative of the UNICEF Executive Director in the country and reports to the Regional Director for general direction and oversight. The Representative is responsible for establishing dialogue with the government to develop the framework of cooperation in the country and for working closely and collaboratively with the government and national institutions, stakeholders and partners, to develop the Government-UNICEF Country Programme of Cooperation in active support of efforts to advance children’s rights as established under the Convention on the Rights of the Child, other international treaties/frameworks, the SDGs, and UN intergovernmental bodies.

item.title: Programme Officer (Budget), P-2, TA (364 days), #00138046, Cox's Bazaar, Bangladesh, APR
item.description: UNICEF Bangladesh is seeking a dynamic and analytically strong Programme Officer (Budget), P2 to support programme financial management for the Rohingya Refugee Response in Cox’s Bazar. This is a unique opportunity to contribute to a large-scale and complex humanitarian operation, supporting the planning, allocation, and monitoring of a diverse portfolio of grants from multiple donors. Working at the intersection of programme and grant management, you will play a critical role in ensuring resources are used efficiently, compliantly, and strategically to maximize results for children and vulnerable communities.In this role, you will go beyond traditional budgeting by providing high-quality financial analysis, funding gap insights, and decision support to senior management in a dynamic and rapidly evolving environment. You will contribute to inter-agency financial transparency through reporting to platforms such as the Rohingya Coordination Platform (RCP) and the Financial Tracking Service (FTS), while strengthening grant management systems and capacity across programme teams. If you are detail-oriented, solutions-driven, and motivated to apply your financial expertise to humanitarian impact on a scale, this role offers a meaningful opportunity to shape how resources translate into results on the ground.

item.title: Health Specialist (P-3), TA (6 months), #139149, Phnom Penh, Cambodia - APR
item.description: UNICEF Cambodia is looking for a Health Specialist to help the Government integrate non-communicable diseases (NCDs) into primary health care and community outreach platforms, under the new Country Programme 2024-2028. Reporting to the Chief of Health and Nutrition, you will support programme planning, monitoring and delivery of results; provide technical guidance to government and partners; build partnerships; and generate evidence and innovation on prevention, promotion and referral pathways, children’s environmental health, mental health and climate-smart health services. You bring an advanced degree in a relevant health field, at least five years of relevant professional experience, and fluency in English. Join UNICEF and help every child survive, develop and reach their full potential.

item.title: Chief Child Protection (P-4), TA (364 days), #00139652, Caracas – Venezuela, LACR
item.description: The Chief is responsible for managing and supervising all stages of child protection programmes/projects from strategic planning and formulation to delivery of concrete and sustainable contributions to national and international efforts to create a protective environment for children against all harm and to protect their rights to survival, development and well-being, as established under the Convention on the Rights of the Child, international treaties/frameworks and UN intergovernmental bodies.

item.title: Technical Specialist, P-3, Temporary Appointment, 364 days, Supply Division, Copenhagen, Denmark, #00139583,
item.description: Support UNICEF’s strategies in collaboration with counterparts in the commercial team, Country Offices and Programme Group, to strengthen country capacity in the area of procurement and supply of medical equipment, devices and instruments, and PPE.

item.title: Chief - Operational Analysis & Technology (Supply Chain) Centre, P-5, Fixed Term Position, Supply Division, Copenhagen, Denmark, #00065671
item.description: Under the overall guidance of the Deputy Director, Operations, the Chief, OATC provides digital and technology leadership, data governance, data management & platforms, AI and Information Security in support of the Supply Division and UNICEF Supply function The Chief oversees the management of the digital, technology and data components of optimization projects and ICT service provision including information and cyber security, business continuity arrangements. The Chief also provides advice on the governance of digital supply chain investments, supply chain optimization initiatives and interagency ICT arrangements. S/he collaborates with UNICEF Digital Impact Division (DID), UNICEF Office of Strategy and Evidence (OSE), other HQ Divisions, and UN City Common Services (ICT) in Copenhagen, and is responsible for the management of the centre, its staff, work planning, progress monitoring and reporting, and performance appraisal, and budget.

item.title: Contracts Manager (P-4), Fixed Term, #00043416, Supply Division (NCDC) - Copenhagen, Denmark
item.description: The Contracts Manager – Child Development and Education (CDE) support the Chief of the Nutrition and Child Development Centre (NCDC) by overseeing end‑to‑end procurement and contracting processes for education, early childhood development, and child protection supplies. The role ensures that procurement is efficient, transparent, and fully aligned with UNICEF’s mandate to advance early learning, safe and stimulating environments, and equitable access to essential developmental and educational materials for children in diverse contexts.

item.title: Supply & Logistics Manager (P-4), FT, #00127607, Gaza, Palestine, MENA
item.description: The Supply and Logistics Manager reports to the Chief of Supply or Chief Field Office as per the Country Office (CO) set-up and is responsible for managing the supply chains of a medium to large-sized country office, and/or medium sized emergency response operation. The supply chain operations include planning, procurement, contracting, customs clearance, warehousing, in-country transport and distribution, as well as monitoring of supplies, services and construction works. The incumbent collaborates closely with programmes in defining supply interventions to meet programmatic needs and achieve results for children, and provides technical and advisory support to governments, national systems and partners on supply chain management.

item.title: Evaluation Specialist, P-3, Temporary Position, 364 days, #00129436, Regional Services Div (ESAR)- Prog Section, Nairobi
item.description: Reporting to the Regional Adviser Evaluation and working closely with the Evaluation Specialist, the Evaluation Specialist works with the UNICEF Evaluation Section in close coordination with the Global Programme Division (GPD) – WASH, in implementing and supporting the generation of evaluative evidence on the R-WASH programme. The Evaluation Specialist also works with KFW and UNHCR to ensure that programmatic perspectives of KFW and UNHCR are factored into evidence generation activities. This is a temporary appointment contract for 364 days (1 year).

item.title: Partnerships Specialist (Resource Mobilization) (P-3), FT, #139243, Djibouti, Djibouti - ESAR
item.description: The purpose of the Partnerships Specialist (Resource Mobilization) position is to deepen collaboration with key stakeholders and provide an integrated interface for environmental scanning, knowledge exchange, resource mobilization, policy influence, advocacy and strategic communication.Under the direct supervision of the Representative, the Specialist leads and coordinates the Country Office’s positioning and engagement with partners, ensures coherence between partnership development, advocacy priorities and external communication, and serves as a strategic adviser to the Representative and senior management. The Specialist supervises staff responsible for advocacy and communication, sets priorities and work plans, provides technical guidance and coaching, assures the quality and consistency of outputs, and fosters effective collaboration across the office. The key result is stronger partnerships, increased and more diversified resources, greater visibility and influence for UNICEF, and sustained support for the realization of children’s rights in Djibouti.Impact of Results:The Partnerships Specialist (Resource Mobilization) is a seasoned professional in the field of external relations, in particular partnership development and resource mobilization. The quality of work and external communications performed by the Specialist directly impacts on the overall reputation of UNICEF. The Specialist follows established procedures but is expected to make recommendations on strategies for engagement and communications products. The Partnerships Specialist (Resource Mobilization) is accountable for quality, substantive input and ability to project a competent and trusted image of UNICEF to partners.

item.title: Programme Specialist (PSEA), P-3, TA (364 days), #139677, Kabul, Afghanistan - APR (Open to non-Afghan nationals)
item.description: UNICEF Afghanistan is seeking a Programme Specialist (Safeguarding/PSEA), P3, on a 364 days Temporary Appointment based in Kabul. The role provides technical and strategic support to strengthen safeguarding and PSEA measures across programmes and operations. Its main focus is survivor-centred case handling, donor compliance for IFI (WB/ADB) activities, and capacity building for partners.

item.title: Deputy Representative Operations, (P-5) Fixed Term, #1379 – Jakarta, Indonesia, APRO
item.description: UNICEF Indonesia Country Office is seeking a dynamic, experienced, and committed professional for the position of Deputy Representative, Operations (P-5). This is an exciting opportunity to contribute strategically to the achievement of UNICEF's mission and results for children. The Operations function supports the Head of the Office on managing the office and monitoring operations and programmes as needed, while providing advice on best and innovative management practices to enhance office performance. The function is a strategic Business Partner role within the Senior Management team, assuring the best use of UNICEF assets in alignment with sound management practices, office priorities and goals to deliver results for children.

item.title: Programme Specialist (P-3), TA (6 months), #134375, Ouagadougou, Burkina Faso-WCAR
item.description: Under the supervision of the Deputy Representative, the Programme Specialist - Resilience will be accountable for programme, planning, design, implementation and administration of specific projects within a major programme, in accordance with the Country Programme Recommendation and Country Programme Management Plan, focussed on achievement of UNICEF's Priorities.

item.title: Technical Officer (Medical Devices), P2, Temporary Appointment (350 days), Copenhagen, Denmark #00139582
item.description: The position is based in UNICEF’s Health Technology Unit in Copenhagen and provides technical, contractual, and operational expertise to support medical supply procurement for routine programmes, emergencies, and partner organizations. It is responsible for managing a portfolio of medical equipment and supplies, developing technical specifications and procurement standards for Maternal, Neonatal and Child Health (MNCH), and strengthening countries’ procurement and supply capacities in collaboration with UNICEF teams and partners.

item.title: Knowledge Management Specialist, P-3, TA (7 months), #00139603. Regional Services Div, Amman - MENAR
item.description: The candidate is expected during the seven-month appointment to deliver the following : RMT and DROPS meetings supported through complete, timely meeting packages, decision records, and regularly updated action trackers.Priority executive briefs, talking points, presentations, correspondence, and consolidated inputs delivered to the required standard and timeline.A maintained change-management workplan and progress tracker, with documented consultations and follow-up actions involving CoEs and relevant offices.Priority knowledge platforms and repositories kept current, with key records and products consistently organized and accessible.Selected lessons, good practices, and learning products captured and disseminated, with continuity and handover materials completed before the end of the appointment.

item.title: Programme Specialist (Climate & Resilience), P-3, Fixed Term, Tadjourah, Djibouti, #00139247
item.description: The Programme Specialist (Climate & Resilience), will serve as technical lead on climate resilience across the programme and all sections; head of the Tadjourah zone office; and emergency focal point of the office. The incumbent is accountable for the planning, design, implementation, monitoring and administration of climate resilience interventions across the programme and of the programme interventions in the north, in accordance with the country programme and the country programme management plan.Key functions, accountabilities and related duties/tasks:Within the delegated authority and the given organizational set-up, the incumbent leads climate resilience across the programme, heads the Tadjourah zone office and acts as emergency focal point of the office. 1. Technical leadership on climate resilience across the programme2. Leadership of the Tadjourah zone office3. Emergency preparedness and response4. Programme planning, monitoring and use of funds5. Partnerships, coordination and resource mobilization6. Capacity building and knowledge management

item.title: People and Culture Officer (Organizational Culture and Change) (P-2), FT, #00139250, Djibouti - Djibouti, ESAR
item.description: People and Culture Officer (Organizational Culture and Change) is an exciting opportunity to help shape an inclusive, respectful and high-performing workplace within UNICEF Djibouti. The role supports organizational culture, employee engagement, change management, knowledge management and organizational learning initiatives across the country office. Working closely with leadership and colleagues across functions, the incumbent will drive continuous improvement, strengthen collaboration, facilitate staff engagement processes, support organizational change efforts and help build practical systems that improve learning, knowledge sharing and organizational effectiveness.

item.title: Programme Budget Officer, P-2, Fixed Term Position,National Team, Sudan, #00139034
item.description: Under the guidance of the Senior Programme Manager, this post supports the World Bank partnership portfolio of approximately USD 200 million by providing financial analysis, budgeting support, and coordination with programme teams. It ensures the effective application of financial rules, timely and high-quality responses, and strengthened alignment with donor requirements across implementing sections. This role also contributes to capacity-building and improved financial management practices to meet World Bank conditions and UNICEF policies.

item.title: Chief Child Protection (P-4), FT, #00022592, Manila - Philippines
item.description: Join our team as our Chief of Child Protection in Manila. You will be responsible for managing and supervising all stages of child protection programmes/projects from strategic planning and formulation to delivery of concrete and sustainable contributions to national and international efforts to create a protective environment for children against all harm and to protect their rights to survival, development and well-being, as established under the Convention on the Rights of the Child, international treaties/frameworks and UN intergovernmental bodies.

item.title: Internship - Section Planning, Suivi & Evaluation, Rabat, Maroc, 3 mois
item.description: Le bureau de l’UNICEF au Maroc cherche à recruter un(e) stagiaire pour accompagner les travaux de la section Planning, Suivi et Évaluation et contribuer aux différents processus de suivi de la performance, d’analyse des données et d’évaluation des programmes.

item.title: Nutrition Manager (P-4), TA, #00139115, Kano - Nigeria, 364 days
item.description: UNICEF Nigeria Field Office in Kano Nigeria is seeking a passionate and committed person to work in the role of a Nutrition Manager and invites applications from highly motivated and committed persons who want to contribute to results for children. If you are that person, we encourage you to apply and become part of a highly motivated and committed team

item.title: Health Specialist (Information Systems) (P-4), Fixed Term, #00133458, Global Programme Division, Health, Nairobi - Kenya CoE
item.description: UNICEF is seeking a highly qualified Health Specialist (Information Systems), P-4, based in Nairobi, Kenya, to provide specialized technical expertise in strengthening digital health information systems. The role focuses on advancing interoperable, standards-based and sustainable digital health platforms, including health management information systems, community health information systems and digital clinical decision-support tools. You will provide technical advisory support to UNICEF Country Offices and governments on platform assessment, interoperability, data governance and system sustainability, contributing to stronger primary health care systems and improved health outcomes for children.

item.title: Senior Legal Affairs Specialist, P-5, FT, #113908 Office of Executive Director, NYHQ
item.description: We seek to hire an experienced Senior Legal Affairs Specialist on a fixed-term appointment to join the Legal Team in our New York Office. The initial appointment will be for a period of two years, with the possibility of extension. Members of the UNICEF Legal Team are expected to be open-minded and resourceful, responsive, and dynamic, transparent and approachable, and clear and authoritative. The overall direction of the Legal Team is set by the Chief Legal Counsel, Office of the Executive Director, New York.

item.title: Deputy Director (Financial Reporting and Grants Management Section), D-1, Division of Financial and Administrative Management (DFAM), New York, USA
item.description:
Under the overall guidance of the Comptroller and Director of the Division of Financial and Administrative Management (DFAM), the Deputy Director (Financial Reporting and Grants Management Section) provides strategic leadership and oversight of UNICEF’s financial reporting, accounting, grants management and corporate resource management functions.
As a member of the DFAM Senior Management Team, the incumbent contributes to divisional priorities, champions financial management reforms and promotes sound financial stewardship across the organization. The role oversees the preparation of UNICEF’s annual financial statements, Executive Board resource management documents, donor financial reports and other corporate financial information, ensuring compliance with International Public Sector Accounting Standards (IPSAS), UNICEF’s Financial Regulations and Rules, and applicable policies.
The Deputy Director also leads corporate resource planning and management, strengthens financial systems and internal controls, and ensures the effective allocation, utilization and safeguarding of financial resources in alignment with UNICEF’s Strategic Plan. The incumbent provides authoritative financial advice and analysis to senior management, including the Office of the Executive Director, and supports the Comptroller and Deputy Executive Director – Management in representing UNICEF before the Executive Board, ACABQ and Fifth Committee on financial and audit matters.

item.title: Programme Budget Specialist (P-3), TA (364 days), #139068, Abuja, Nigeria-WCAR
item.description: Join UNICEF Nigeria Country Office in Abuja, Nigeria as the Programme Budget Specialist and contribute to providing technical support to strengthen the culture of results-based programme budgeting, and ensure alignment and linkage with the results-based planning, monitoring, reporting and resource mobilization priorities. We invite applications from highly motivated and committed persons who want to contribute to results for every child.

item.title: Chief Child Protection, P-4, FT, #020501, Niamey - Niger, WCAR
item.description: The fundamental mission of UNICEF is to promote the rights of every child, everywhere, in everything the organization does — in programmes, in advocacy and in operations. The equity strategy, emphasizing the most disadvantaged and excluded children and families, translates this commitment to children’s rights into action.

item.title: Market Research Specialist, P-3 (TA for 364 days) Private Fund Raising and Partnerships, #00139076, Rome, Italy
item.description: Are you passionate about turning audience and market research into strategies that make a difference? UNICEF is looking for an experienced Market Research Specialist (P-3) to join the Audience & Market Insights team in Rome. You will lead innovative audience insight and research initiatives, collaborate with stakeholders across regions and markets, and transform complex evidence into actionable recommendations that strengthen UNICEF’s fundraising, advocacy and communications. This is an opportunity to bring your research expertise, strategic thinking and innovative approaches, including AI-enabled insights, to work with global reach and impact.

item.title: Supply Chain Officer (Monitoring), P-2, Temporary Position, 364 days, Supply Division, Copenhagen, Denmark, #00139106
item.description: Under the supervision of the Supply Chain Specialist (Supply Chain Intelligence pillar in MSDC) and within the framework of UNICEF’s Supply Chain Digitalization Initiative, the incumbent is responsible for: (1) supporting the continuous development and enhancement of UNICEF’s supply information systems, including VISION/SAP, Info Hub and InSight, to meet supply visibility needs; (2) ensuring reports, data and supply intelligence are made available as needed via UNICEF’s progressively available digital solutions; and (3) supporting the development of capacities within the supply community on supply intelligence and digital dexterity.

item.title: Investigation Officer (P-2), FT, #00086112, Office of Internal Audit & Investigation, Internal Audit & Investigation, O/P Budapest
item.description: The Office of Internal Audit and Investigations (OIAI) is an independent office reporting to UNICEF's Executive Director and the Executive Board. The Investigations Service investigates reports of possible violations of rules or regulations, mismanagement, misconduct, waste of resources or abuse of authority. The position is located in Budapest, under the general guidance of the Chief of Investigations, the incumbent assists and supports the Investigations Section in the planning, organization and conduct of investigations into allegations of misconduct and other wrongdoing in or affecting UNICEF. This will include conducting and supporting investigations into sensitive and complex matters, including sexual misconduct matters, specifically Sexual Exploitation and Abuse and Sexual Harassment (SEAH) in accordance with applicable UNICEF policies, procedures, and victim-centered principles. The Investigation Officer will also support the day-to-day operational and specialized activities of the investigation function, to enhance the smooth running of incumbent’s section.

item.title: Chief WASH, P-5, Fixed Term Position, 00047150, Mogadiscio, Somalia - ESAR
item.description: Ready to lead WASH transformation in one of the world’s most complex and dynamic operating environments?UNICEF Somalia is seeking an exceptional Chief WASH, Level 5 to provide strategic, technical and managerial leadership for a high-impact WASH programme serving children and communities affected by climate shocks, displacement and humanitarian crises. This is a unique opportunity to shape the future of WASH in Somalia, bridging life-saving humanitarian action with sustainable, climate-resilient systems and services.The role will drive partnerships with Federal and State Governments, UN and humanitarian partners, donors, International Financial Institutions including the World Bank and African Development Bank, and the private sector. The Chief will champion innovative and blended financing, Public-Private Partnerships, stronger WASH institutions and integrated approaches across Health, Nutrition, Education, Child Protection and Social Protection. The position also carries WASH Cluster coordination responsibilities, putting the successful candidate at the heart of Somalia’s humanitarian-development-peace nexus.If you are an experienced WASH leader who can turn complexity into opportunity, mobilize partnerships and resources, and inspire teams to deliver lasting results for children, we want to hear from you.

item.title: Chief Supply and Logistics, (P-4), FT, #00118872, Port Au Prince, Haiti – LACR
item.description: UNICEF Haiti is seeking a results-driven Chief Supply and Logistics to lead and oversee supply chain operations in support of the Country Office’s emergency response. Based in Port-au-Prince and reporting to the Deputy Representative Operations, you will provide leadership across the full spectrum of supply chain functions, including planning, procurement, contracting, customs clearance, warehousing, in-country transport and distribution, as well as the monitoring of supplies, services and construction works.Working closely with programme teams, you will ensure that supply interventions are aligned with programme priorities and contribute to achieving tangible results for children. You will also provide strategic technical guidance and advisory support to government counterparts, national systems and partners, while driving innovation and strengthening the efficiency, effectiveness and responsiveness of supply chain operations.If you are a strategic leader with strong supply chain expertise and a passion for making a difference for children in Haiti, we would love to hear from you!

item.title: Internship - SBC section Internship (multiple Interns), Yaoundé, Douala, Buea, Maroua, Bertoua, and Ngaoundéré in Cameroun, 6 months (full time)
item.description: UNICEF Cameroun is recruiting 12 Social and Behaviour Change (SBC) interns, deployed in two cohorts of six interns each for a period of six months. During the first phase, six interns will be deployed across UNICEF Cameroon offices as follows: Yaoundé (Centre Region):1 intern, Douala (Littoral Region):1 intern, Buea (South-West Region): 1 intern, Bertoua (East Region): 1 intern, Ngaoundéré (Adamawa Region): 1 intern, and Maroua (Far North Region): 1 intern. The interns will contribute to strengthening community engagement efforts in Child-Friendly Municipalities, expansion of Accountability to Affected Populations, expansion of birth registration and implementation of the initiative to prevent child marriage.

item.title: Batch recruitment: Supply & Logistics Specialist, P-3, Temporary Position, 364 Days, Copenhagen, Denmark #00139157, #00139088
item.description: Effective operationalization of the UN80 Integrated Supply Chain Initiative will strengthen UNICEF’s contribution to a more integrated, efficient and interoperable UN supply chain. Clear operational documents and regular monitoring of key performance indicators will support consistent implementation and give senior management a reliable view of progress and results. Close alignment between the initiative and Supply Division Procurement Centers, together with improved internal procurement processes, will help UNICEF adapt as the initiative expands to more commodities and countries. Practical support to starter countries and to the scale-up of the initiative will help translate UN80 strategies into tangible results, including reduced duplication, lower costs and more reliable delivery of supplies and services to the populations the UN serves, and will position UNICEF as a trusted partner in UN supply chain reform.

item.title: Programme Specialist (Safeguarding), P-3, Temporary Position, 364 days, Education Cannot Wait (ECW), UNICEF Hosted Fund, Geneva, Switzerland, #00138203
item.description: Education Cannot Wait (ECW) is looking for a highly motivated Programme Specialist (Safeguarding) to support and strengthen safeguarding across its multi-country Education in Emergencies (EiE) programmes. Under the general guidance and supervision of the Gender Programme Manager, this critical role within the Programme Delivery and Quality team will conduct PSEA assessments, manage safeguarding incidents and concerns involving partner organizations, and lead partner capacity-strengthening activities. Working across ECW teams and with UNICEF colleagues and ECW-funded partners, the incumbent will support disability inclusion and the effective integration of Protection, Gender and Inclusion (PGI), including through engagement with Local and Women-led Organizations and Organizations of Persons with Disabilities.

item.title: Re-advertisement: Chief of Communication, P-5, FT, #00136826, Saudi Arabia, Riyadh, Gulf Area Office - MENA
item.description: Accountable for developing, managing, co-ordinating, networking, implementing and monitoring an advocacy and communication strategy and associated products and activities on a regular and on-going basis with public audiences, with the objective of promoting awareness, understanding, support and respect for children’s and women’s rights, and support for UNICEF's mission, priorities and programmes in the country office and at a global level and those of the UN Country Team.

item.title: Re-advertisement: Chief Fundraising (Strategic Partnership), P-5, FT, #00136749, Saudi Arabia, Riyadh, Gulf Area Office - MENA
item.description: The Chief Fundraising will be responsible for leading all UNICEF partnerships and fundraising activities from public and private sector, and supporting broader engagement and cultivation of partnerships to leverage results for children locally and globally.

item.title: Social Policy Specialist (BRIDGE Coordination), P-4, Temporary Position, #00139064, Global Programme Division, 364 days, Economic & Social Policy, CoE Amman - Jordan (Fully Remote)
item.description: Join UNICEF as a Social Policy Specialist (BRIDGE Coordination), P-4, based in Amman, Jordan, and play a key role in advancing inclusive social protection for forcibly displaced persons, returnees and host communities. Lead the coordination and operational delivery of the BRIDGE initiative, working closely with UNICEF, UNHCR, ILO and other partners to strengthen inter-agency collaboration, provide high-quality technical assistance and promote evidence-based solutions. This is an opportunity to contribute to more inclusive, resilient and shock-responsive social protection systems through strategic partnerships, technical leadership and coordinated country support.

item.title: Evaluation Specialist (P-4), TA (7 months), #139153, Ha Noi, Viet Nam - APR
item.description: A minimum of 8 years of professional experience in the implementation of equity-focused evaluations and the management of the evaluation function at national and international level. Experience in development and/ or humanitarian settings is required.Experience in supporting national evaluation capacity and working with professional evaluation associations;Experience in evaluation design and in conducting evaluations as per UNICEF and UNEG norms and standards for Evaluation in the UN System;

item.title: Procurement Services Manager, P-4, FT, #70199, Kinshasa, Dem. Rep. of Congo-WCAR
item.description: Are you ready to turn procurement into results for children? Join UNICEF DRC and lead a strategic procurement services portfolio worth about USD 180 million a year across health, nutrition, immunization and education. You will work alongside the Ministry of Health, donors and partners to set up procurement frameworks, promote innovative financing mechanisms, and strengthen national supply chains so life-saving supplies reach every child on time. We're looking for a strategic leader and skilled negotiator who is fluent in French and English and has at least eight years of experience in procurement and supply chain management.

item.title: Donor Relations Specialist (Strategic Partnerships), P3, Temporary Appointment, 364 days (1 year) #139116, Jakarta, Indonesia –for non-Indonesians
item.description: UNICEF Indonesia is looking for a Donor Relations Specialist (Strategic Partnerships) who will provide dedicated capacity to advance a portfolio of high-priority partnership initiatives. The position will work closely with the PFP High Value Partnerships team, Programme Sections and other parts of UNICEF Indonesia teams to connect programme priorities with partner interests, coordinate inputs from across UNICEF Indonesia, and help move strategic opportunities from concept development through partner engagement and follow-up. This is a temporary appointment contract for 364 days (1 year).

item.title: Chief (Good Governance and Child Protection), P-4, Fixed Term Position, #00139430, Ha Noi - Viet Nam, APR
item.description: Join UNICEF Viet Nam as Chief, Good Governance and Child Protection, and lead a transformative agenda that strengthens governance, accountability and child protection systems to advance the rights and well-being of every child. Through strategic leadership, policy influence, partnerships and innovation, the role drives integrated, systems-focused solutions that promote equity, inclusion, participation and access to quality services, delivering sustainable impact for children and adolescents across Viet Nam.

item.title: Quality Assurance Specialist, P-3, Temporary Position, Copenhagen, 364 days, Supply Division, #00139060
item.description: The Quality Assurance Specialist will work within the Quality Inspection Unit-Pharma (QIU-P); which is responsible for ensuring that pharmaceuticals and nutritional products procured by UNICEF for Programmes and Partners meet UNICEF Quality Standards.

item.title: Finance/Budget Manager (P-4), FT, #00131282, Kyiv, Ukraine
item.description: The Ukraine Country Office is a large Country Office, with one of the largest budgets in UNICEF globally, that is implementing both a humanitarian and NEXUS response due to the challenging and sensitive political environment. The Finance/Budget Manager, under the general guidance of the Deputy Representative Operations, will oversee the management of the finance functions and budget for the office and is expected to exhibit a high level of maturity and set high quality objectives, both internally and externally, to deliver results. The Finance/Budget Manager will supervise a team of Finance and Budget staff, collaborating with all sections across the country office, regional office, GSSC and DFAM. The incumbent, when supervising support staff, will be responsible for planning and guiding work in progress and for reviewing work completed by subordinate staff to verify accuracy and compliance with International Public Sector Accounting Standards (IPSAS), UNICEF Financial Regulation and Rules, policies, procedures, guidelines, standards of accountability, and ethics.
